runs.str: 1. A coin is flipped and a six-sided dot cube is tossed.
2. A six-sided dot cube is tossed, and then you spin a spinner
3. You choose an outfit of shirt, jeans, and sneakers.  You have 10 shirts,
5 pairs of jeans, and 2 pairs of sneakers to choose from.
Each event is independent of the other event in these
